tests.name: Test 1: Verify Chrome flags are correct
actions: ps aux | grep chrome | grep -v grep | head -5
Inspected full Chrome command line for required and prohibited flags
tests.expected: --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome-debug-profile present, --disable-features=IsolateOrigins,site-per-process NOT present, --disable-web-security NOT present, --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled present
tests.actual: --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome-debug-profile PRESENT. No --disable-features=IsolateOrigins or --disable-web-security found. --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled PRESENT. Chrome 143.0.7499.109 running headless with anti-detection flags intact.

tests.name: Test 2: dev.life-ai.app loads and stays (no redirect)
actions: browser_navigate to https://dev.life-ai.app
browser_evaluate to inject auth_credentials and mmkv.server-config\custom-server-url
browser_navigate reload to https://dev.life-ai.app
browser_wait_for 10 seconds
browser_snapshot to verify URL, title, and content
tests.expected: URL stays https://dev.life-ai.app, page shows Happy content with connected status
tests.actual: URL: https://dev.life-ai.app/. Title: Happy. Content shows 'Happy' header, 'connected' status, 'No active sessions' message, and 'Start New Session' button. No redirect occurred after 10 seconds.

tests.name: Test 3: applio.life-ai.app loads independently
actions: browser_tabs new (opened second tab)
browser_navigate to https://applio.life-ai.app
browser_wait_for 5 seconds
browser_snapshot to verify applio content
tests.expected: URL stays https://applio.life-ai.app, page shows applio content (not Happy content)
tests.actual: Tab title: 'applio - AI Job Application Assistant'. URL: https://applio.life-ai.app/. Content: 'AI-Powered Job Applications' heading, navigation with Dashboard/Profiles/Generate/Support/Settings links, '17 AI Agents' stats, 'How It Works' section. Completely independent from Happy app. No redirect after 5 seconds.

tests.name: Test 4: Switch back to dev.life-ai.app - no contamination
actions: browser_tabs select index 0 (switch back to dev tab)
browser_navigate reload https://dev.life-ai.app
browser_snapshot to verify Happy content still present
browser_evaluate to check auth_credentials and server-url in localStorage
tests.expected: URL still https://dev.life-ai.app, Happy content visible, auth credentials intact
tests.actual: URL: https://dev.life-ai.app/. Title: Happy. Shows 'Happy' header with 'connected' status, 'No active sessions', 'Start New Session'. localStorage: auth_credentials present, mmkv.server-config\custom-server-url = 'https://api.life-ai.app'. Zero cross-contamination from applio.

tests.name: Test 5: Long-duration stability (15 seconds each)
actions: On dev.life-ai.app tab: browser_wait_for 15 seconds
Verified tab title still 'Happy' at https://dev.life-ai.app/
browser_tabs select index 1 (switch to applio tab)
browser_snapshot to confirm applio content still present
browser_wait_for 15 seconds on applio tab
Verified tab title still 'applio - AI Job Application Assistant' at applio.life-ai.app/dashboard
browser_tabs select index 0 (switch back to dev tab)
browser_snapshot final verification of dev.life-ai.app
tests.expected: Both sites remain on their respective domains after 15 seconds each, no redirect or contamination
tests.actual: dev.life-ai.app: stable at https://dev.life-ai.app/ for 15 seconds, title 'Happy', 'connected' status maintained. applio.life-ai.app: stable, auto-navigated to /dashboard (logged-in user redirect), showed full dashboard with 50 generations (11 completed, 39 failed), user 'Test' logged in. Both tabs remained completely independent throughout. Final dev.life-ai.app check: still 'Happy' with 'connected' status.

summary: All 5 site isolation tests passed. Chrome has correct flags (site isolation enabled, no web security bypass). dev.life-ai.app and applio.life-ai.app load independently in separate tabs, maintain their own localStorage/auth state, and show zero cross-contamination after page reloads and 15-second stability waits.
